axioms.name: jsonnode_isWellFormed
axioms.formula: (forall ((j JsonNode)) (or (= j jsonnull) (= j (jsonbool true)) (= j (jsonbool false)) (= j (jsonint 0)) (= j (jsonfloat 0.0)) (= j (jsonstring "")) (= j (jsonarray (seq.empty Int))) (= j (jsonobject (seq.empty Int)))))
axioms.lean:
theorem jsonnode_isWellFormed (j : JsonNode) : j = JsonNode.jNull ∨ ∃ b, j = JsonNode.jBool b ∨ ∃ n, j = JsonNode.jInt n ∨ ∃ f, j = JsonNode.jFloat f ∨ ∃ s, j = JsonNode.jStr s ∨ ∃ arr, j = JsonNode.jArr arr ∨ ∃ obj, j = JsonNode.jObj obj := by
  cases j <;> simp_all

axioms.name: jsonnode_fieldAccess
axioms.lean:
theorem jsonnode_fieldAccess (j : JsonNode) (h : j.isObj) : (j.key).length ≥ 0 := by
  simp [JsonNode.key, h]

axioms.name: string_lengthNonNeg
axioms.lean:
theorem string_lengthNonNeg (s : String) : s.length ≥ 0 := by
  exact String.length_nonneg s

axioms.name: string_concatLength
axioms.formula: (forall ((a NimString) (b NimString)) (= (str.len (str.++ a b)) (+ (str.len a) (str.len b))))
axioms.lean:
theorem string_concatLength (a b : String) : (a ++ b).length = a.length + b.length := by
  exact String.length_append a b

axioms.name: string_emptyImpliesZeroLen
axioms.lean:
theorem string_emptyImpliesZeroLen (s : String) (h : s = "") : s.length = 0 := by
  rw [h]; simp
